title_as_printed: Dissolved methane concentrations (in mole fraction of methane, X(CH4)) calculated from Raman peak-area ratios (PAR) from the spectra of aqueous solutions in equilibrium with sI methane hydrate
pressure_note: pressure of the liquid-water + hydrate system in the absence of a vapour phase (in situ cell pressure); not a gas partial pressure

value.what: CH4 mole fraction in water in equilibrium with sI hydrate, computed from PAR using the authors' calibration Eq. (2); salt-free, pure water

value2.what: Raman peak-area ratio CH4 (about 2910 cm-1) to water, the primary measurement

notes: Table printed as two side-by-side blocks (left: 40 MPa, 22 rows; right: 30, 20 and 10 MPa, 22 rows); stacked left first then right. Text says sixty measurements; table prints 44 rows. Replicate rows are exact repeats of conditions, kept.
quality_reason: mole fraction derived through a Raman calibration anchored to an equation of state (audit 2026-10-02)
